missing_information: 55 of 61 turbine identities and their manufacturer curves
fifth-degree CT(CPe) coefficients and source samples
MATLAB population size, elite, crossover, mutation, stall, and parallel options
random states, repeat count, trajectories, and machine-readable optimum layouts
completion_decisions: Anchor the six published turbine rows exactly and complete all other codes with a deterministic, nondecreasing rated-power catalog spanning the published diameter and rated-speed ranges.
Use a monotone quintic smoothstep from cut-in to rated power as the missing fifth-degree manufacturer-curve completion.
Use a bounded fifth-degree CT(CPe) curve as the missing generic thrust-coefficient completion.
Use the paper's Frandsen-expanded Jensen wake, exact circle-intersection overlap fraction, log-law shear, and quadratic wake-deficit superposition.
Use population 256, 5 percent elites, 0.8 scattered crossover, bounded per-gene mixed-variable mutation, and a 50-generation stall window as declared MATLAB-ga-lineage completions.
Use counter-keyed random events, fixed-index writes, stable sorting, and ordered elitist commits to preserve one/all-core scientific identity.
Exclude cited or plotted non-target comparison baselines; all three objectives and all paper problem roles remain targets.

layouts: six turbines in line with variable downwind locations
objectives_optimized_separately: minimum total cost index per output power

decision_and_constraints.turbine_in_line: six continuous y positions, six integer turbine codes, and six integer hub heights
decision_and_constraints.small_wind_farm: 18 integer turbine codes and 18 integer hub heights at fixed positions
decision_and_constraints.turbine_code: integer 1 through 61, nondecreasing in rated power

physics_and_cost.wake: Frandsen-expanded Jensen radius, log-law expansion coefficient, exact partial rotor-wake overlap, and root-sum-square deficits
physics_and_cost.power: commercial turbine-specific declared quintic completion below rated speed and rated power above rated speed
physics_and_cost.capacity_factor: sum output power divided by sum rated power

algorithm.mutation: independent per-gene probability 1/dimension; turbine-code redraw, bounded integer hub-height step, and bounded continuous TIL displacement

physical_fes_ledger.unit: one complete commercial-turbine, height-dependent wake, power, capacity-factor, cost, and constraint evaluation of one physical layout
physical_fes_ledger.variation_and_selection: do not consume physical wind-farm FES

hpc_execution.single_run: one persistent all-core worker team parallelizes population initialization, mixed-variable offspring construction, and full physical layout evaluations
hpc_execution.ordered_semantics: counter-keyed random events, fixed-index writes, stable ordering, and ordered elite commits preserve one/all-worker scientific identity
hpc_execution.irreducible_control: generation termination and deterministic population ordering remain serial control dependencies
hpc_execution.formal_resource_rule: one optimization process owns every Waffle CPU core; cases and 25 seeds run sequentially without nested oversubscription
hpc_execution.timings: physical evaluator, algorithm-only, and end-to-end wall times are reported separately

paper_native_formal_protocol.formal_stopping: TolFun=1e-15 over the declared 50-generation stall window, otherwise the 3000-generation maximum
paper_native_formal_protocol.h6_case: staggered, S=4, Uref=10 m/s, offshore, minimum TCIOP
formal_outputs: best mixed-variable decision and complete physical evaluation
